description.value: A faint green glow fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range, curling around obstacles, and persists as long as you concentrate, up to 10 minutes. Whenever a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or begins its turn there, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 necrotic damage, gain one level of exhaustion, and begin shedding a dim green glow in a 5-foot radius that prevents it from benefiting from invisibility. Both the glow and any exhaustion gained this way fade when the power ends.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
